candidates.title: TLS certificate verification is disabled in HTTPS agent
candidates.evidence:
The product specification requires that TLS connection certificate verification be mandatory for live mode evaluation. However, the source code in src/client.ts explicitly sets rejectUnauthorized to false when creating the https.Agent. This configuration disables the verification of the server's SSL/TLS certificate, making the connection vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks. This directly violates the stated requirement.
固定snapshot原文: export const client = new https.Agent({ rejectUnauthorized: false });
candidates.remediation: Change rejectUnauthorized to true or remove the option to use the default secure behavior. Ensure that valid CA certificates are available in the environment if custom CAs are used.

candidates.evidence:

However, the source code in src/client.ts explicitly sets rejectUnauthorized to false when creating the https.Agent. This configuration disables the verification of the server's SSL/TLS certificate, making the connection vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks. This directly violates the stated requirement.

candidates.remediation: Remove the rejectUnauthorized: false option or set it to true to enforce certificate verification. Ensure that valid CA certificates are available in the trust store.
